zoe_cs: Customer 'lumen-ai' onboarding hit a burst of 429s during SDK prefetch on mobile that only appears behind their proxy. They sent a tiny repro.
ops-bot: Alert: preflight_burst tenant=lumen-ai concurrent=14 :warning:
rahul_eng: can you paste the short log snippet? even a few lines helps.
zoe_cs: redacted trace: ```[2026-05-02T07:22:10Z] preflight start ttl=8s token=tokA
[2026-05-02T07:22:10Z] preflight start ttl=8s token=tokB
[2026-05-02T07:22:10Z] gateway: validated two tokens -> counted as 2 preflights -> quota 429
```
zoe_cs: header dump shows both `Authorization` and `x-lumen-token` being sent across concurrent streams.
dana_sdk: root cause seems to be short ephemeral TTL (8s) + concurrent prefetches from multiple threads/workers + their wrapper adding extra header. Quick mitigations: (1) SDK singleflight per token-hash for 300ms, (2) default doc guidance bump TTL to 60s for mobile, (3) server-side prefer `Authorization` if duplicate headers present and emit a warning header to help customers detect wrappers.
rahul_eng: agree. I'll open a small PR for singleflight + 200ms jitter and an opt-in flag collapseRefresh=true.
ops-bot: Note: temporary quota overrides will emit billing events.
zoe_cs: CS plan: (A) request tenant quota bump 10->30 for 12h (ticket ONB-4012), (B) ship SDK canary and get customer to test, (C) monitor preflight metric for 6h. I'll own customer comms.
rahul_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/900. Backport planned for 2.x.
dana_sdk: will add docs note and the opt-in flag.
zoe_cs: tagging owners: @rahul_eng (SDK PR), @dana_sdk (docs/backport), @zoe_cs (CS). Closing when metrics stable or after 12h window. Thanks!
